latest.title: The Schrödinger equation with fluctuating nonlinearity in the energy space
latest.abstract: We study nonlinear Schrödinger equations with nonlinear Stratonovich noise \begin{equation*} \mathrm{d} u\,=\, i\bigl[ Δu \,+\, λ|u|^{p-1}u\bigr] \, \mathrm{d} t \,+\,i|u|^{(q-1)/2}u\circ \mathrm{d} {W}, \end{equation*} in their energy space $H^1(\mathbb R^d;\mathbb C)$. By combining the stochastic Strichartz estimates derived in [Potential Anal. 41 (2014), pp.\ 269--315] with the approach from [Ann.\ Inst.\ H.\ Poincaré Phys.\ Théor.\ 46 (1987), pp.\ 113--129] we obtain local well-posedness for all energy-subcritical nonlinearities $p,q\in [1, 1+4/(d-2)_+)$ together with a corresponding blow-up alternative. For a linear multiplicative noise $q=1$, a real-valued noise $W$ and a defocusing nonlinearity $λ\le 0$, we check this blow-up condition using a bound on the energy, resulting in the global well-posedness of the equation. If both nonlinearities are mass-subcritical, i.e., $p,q\in [1, 1+4/d)$, we provide an improved blow-up criterion involving the $L^2(\mathbb R^d;\mathbb C)$-norm. Using the conservation of mass for real-valued $W$, we obtain global well-posedness also in this case. Compared to previous results on stochastic nonlinear Schrödinger equations, we thereby improve the range of exponents $p$ and $q$ and the spatial regularity assumption on the noise.
latest.workSummary: 论文在 $H^1(R^d;C)$ 能量空间研究带非线性 Stratonovich 噪声的 nonlinear Schrödinger equation。作者先将随机积分方程局部化，结合 stochastic Strichartz estimates 与截断映射证明所有 energy-subcritical p,q 的局部适定性和 blow-up alternative。对线性 multiplicative noise、实值噪声和 defocusing drift，Ito energy identity 给出能量控制并排除 blow-up；当 p,q mass-subcritical 时，质量守恒和改进的 L2 blow-up criterion 进一步得到全局适定。
latest.breakthrough: 把 $H^1$ 局部理论推进到同时含 nonlinear drift 和 nonlinear Stratonovich noise 的完整 energy-subcritical 指数范围，并在实值噪声下给出 defocusing 与 mass-subcritical 情形的全局适定性。
latest.limitations: 局部理论依赖 noise coefficient 的 regularity/Assumption 3.1 和 energy-subcritical 指数；全局结论需要 $q=1$ 或 mass-subcritical、实值噪声及 defocusing 等附加条件，不能覆盖 focusing energy-critical 或粗糙复值噪声。

steps.claim: 截断后的随机 NLS 在 $H^1$ 中具有局部解、唯一性和连续依赖。
steps.route: 把 Duhamel map 放入 admissible stochastic Strichartz 空间，非线性和噪声系数的局部 Lipschitz 界使短时间映射收缩；Lipschitz truncation 先处理非全局增长，再逐步去掉截断。
steps.evidence: PDF 第 9-14 页 Section 3 Theorems 3.8–3.11、Lemmas 3.14–3.19。

steps.claim: 局部解满足 maximal lifespan 的 blow-up alternative。
steps.route: 若 maximal time 有限，则 Strichartz norm 必须发散；反之在有限 Strichartz norm 下由局部 contraction 从末端时刻重新启动，延长解并产生矛盾。
steps.evidence: PDF 第 14-16 页 Theorem 3.8 与 Proposition 4.1。

steps.claim: 在实值线性乘性噪声和 defocusing 条件下，能量界排除有限时刻 blow-up。
steps.route: 对 stochastic energy 使用 Ito formula，实值噪声的随机项与 Laplacian/noise commutator 按假设抵消或可积控制；defocusing nonlinear potential 非负，期望/路径能量界给出 $H^1$ 与 Strichartz 有界。
steps.evidence: PDF 第 24-30 页 Section 4 Propositions 4.1–4.3；energy estimates and blow-up criterion。

steps.claim: mass-subcritical p,q 情形中质量守恒改进 blow-up criterion 并推出 global well-posedness。
steps.route: 先由 Proposition 5.1 的实噪声质量守恒控制 L2 norm，再用 Gagliardo–Nirenberg 将 nonlinear potential 和 noise term 估计为质量乘 $H^1$ 的次临界幂；因此 $H^1$ 不会在有限时间发散。
steps.evidence: PDF 第 31-34 页 Section 5 Propositions 5.1–5.3 与 Theorem 1.1 proof。

latest.aiEvidence: 作者在 AI disclosure statement 中明确披露 GPT-5.6 by OpenAI 用于 proofreading，并说明该工具未用于生成数学内容或研究结果；proofreading 属于论文制作，按规则计为 explicit。
latest.aiEvidenceSource: PDF 第 18 页 AI disclosure statement。
latest.priorityReason: 论文聚焦色散方程，主要进展属于奇性与适定性；排序综合考虑其与 PDE 机制、可复用估计、正则性和长时间行为的相关程度。
